name: From Rags To Riches Pet Shop Cinderella
original_name: From Rags To Riches Pet Shop Cinderella
overview: By a twist of fate, pet shop owner Elise Moore got married in a whirlwind to billionaire Alexander Alger. Due to misunderstandings, Alexander had to disguise his identity to prevent him from being exposed. With Elise believing her husband to be an ordinary person, what kind of funny stories will unfold between them?
